revisions.reason: freeze full Beacon design/product/prototype rebuild with ordered design capability sub-contracts
expand beacon-design subskill contract to preserve ui-ux-dev upstream capability routes

state_machine: `design_result_accepted -> implementation_allowed` without binding.
`design_truth_bound -> implementation_allowed` when PRD / user-story / test-case are stale.
`legacy_wireframe_present -> implementation_allowed` for v1.4.11+ current design closure.
`implementation_allowed`: design/product truth and requirement truth agree.
`blocked_accepted_ui_ux_truth_gap`: accepted design facts exist but are unbound.
`blocked_requirement_truth_stale`: design facts affect requirements but change/refreeze is missing.
`legacy_migration_input_only`: old wireframe can be inspected but cannot satisfy current design closure.
decision_priority: Human-accepted design facts cannot be silently ignored.
Beacon Markdown truth must be updated before execution trusts it.
`PRODUCT.md` / `DESIGN.md` participate when design facts affect product or visual baseline.
PRD / user-story / test-case must update when design facts change promise, behavior, AC, or QA coverage.
`prototype adapt` records accepted design result binding; it does not bypass change/refreeze.
legacy wireframe is inspection / migration input only.
open-source component design guidance must remain auditable and deterministic enough for tests.
`ui-ux-dev` remains optional external execution power, not canonical truth.
